score_rationale: Ralph has relevant skills in livestock handling and independent rural work, which align well with the core duties of the groundskeeping role and handling 'consenting quarry'. However, he lacks essential experience in tracking, bloodhound management, and the specific pursuit protocols required for the Hunt Coordinator position.
key_strengths: Proven experience in livestock handling and welfare, strong record-keeping skills, and demonstrated ability to work independently in challenging rural environments.
key_weaknesses: Lack of direct experience with bloodhounds, tracking, search & rescue, or military-type pursuit activities, which are central to the Hunt Coordinator responsibilities.
final_evaluation: Ralph has some foundational strengths for the role, particularly in hands-on rural management and discretion, but the critical gaps in tracking-specific expertise and bloodhound handling make it unlikely he would be a suitable fit for the unique demands of this position.
